title: Merge K Sorted Lists - Solution
intuition: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(n log k) where n is total node count
common_mistakes: Push the head nodes of all k sorted lists into a min-heap.
Pop node with smallest value, link it, and push its next node.
